verdict.rationale: Event subscriptions via webhooks are a fair question for a national company registry, since registries can publish change or filing event feeds, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt 403 probes, on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing about webhooks, event subscriptions or any API. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none; confidence is low because nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched.
